scenario: LGRA.10.3.5: a kwarg is named at most once per action, so a `call` naming the declared service kwarg `alpha` twice is DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_KWARG. Drives `dsc.validate`'s `lgra_10_3_5_duplicate_kwarg` over the call's inline arguments, the user-declared namespace of LGRA.10.3.4. Both occurrences are declared and well-typed, so neither the undeclared-kwarg check (`call_kwarg_known`) nor a value type check can refuse the program in its place.
rules_ds:
use default

service svc.body:
    kwarg alpha: Int
    no response

schema In scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule out:
    In i
->
    call svc.body alpha: i.id alpha: 2 nocooldown
